description: This file defines the BucketEndpointMiddleware class used in the AWS SDK for PHP to modify S3 request endpoints, specifically handling bucket endpoints and CNAME buckets.

classes.name: BucketEndpointMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for adjusting the host and path of S3 requests to support bucket endpoints and CNAMEs.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Static method that returns a callable to wrap a handler with this middleware.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the middleware with the next handler in the chain.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the middleware, modifying the request if necessary based on the bucket name.

methods.name: removeBucketFromPath
methods.description: Removes the bucket name from the URI path, handling duplicate occurrences.

methods.name: removeDuplicateBucketFromHost
methods.description: Removes duplicate bucket segments from the host, if present.

methods.name: getBucketNameOccurrencesInKey
methods.description: Counts how many times the bucket name occurs in the key path segments.

methods.name: modifyRequest
methods.description: Modifies the request URI to adjust the host and path based on bucket configurations.
